dataset: ISIC 2018 Task 3 training (HAM10000) ground truth, melanoma (MEL) vs all other classes
sampling: seed 2026; 150 melanoma + 350 non-melanoma drawn without replacement (melanoma enriched vs ~11% in the dataset; AUC does not depend on prevalence)
scope: Measures how well the hand-set score ranks melanoma above other lesions on dermoscopy images. Not clinical accuracy, sensitivity/specificity, or patient-level performance.
